jobs.title: Radar Scenario Development Engineer / Systems Engineer - Colorado Springs, CO
jobs.description:
Davidson is distinguished in the aerospace and missile defense industry, in part, because of its excellence in hiring exceptional experts, engineers and software developers dedicated to delivering advanced, intelligent technology solutions in defense of our nation.

Davidson is seeking a Radar Scenario Development Engineer / Systems Engineer
- Colorado Springs, CO - Colorado Springs, CO.

This position is located at a site that is NOT on a military base or military installation.

Will support the Missile Defense Sensors (MDS) department. The MDS department delivers cutting-edge expertise in concept development, architectural design, requirements generation and flow-down, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, integration, test, and evaluation of world-class Missile Defense & Sensor Systems. You will play a critical part in the enhancement and modernization of Ground-Based Radar (GBR) Systems. Your contributions will include developing and analyzing system requirements, designing system architectures, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver advanced radar solutions.

Job Responsibilities

Creation of necessary objects/characteristics and conditions including environmental factors(clutter/iono/etc.) necessary to test requirements.
Scenario definition development incorporating object.
Scenario executable compilation.
Maintain inventory/database list and versions (mapped to applicable test cases) identifying objects/characteristics/environmental factors.
Document objectives/description of scenario and desired functional outcomes.
Investigation of scenario issues.
Modification of scenarios to accommodate updates to requirements as applicable for new conditions/characteristics for objects or environmental factors.
Scenario analysis support for test case execution.
Database of all final scenarios.

Job Requirements

BS or MS in Engineering, Science, Math or related discipline
2-4 years' experience DOORS/Cameo requirements modeling/scripting and test case defeminization
Early Warning Radar (EWR) Hardware and/or Software experience
Knowledge of requirements development methodology
Proficiency in radar test methodology
Proficiency in MATLAB scripting for data analysis
Prior experience in radar requirements development
Scenario generation experience
Test case design experience

Desired Competencies

Experience with radar system concepts including detection, discrimination, tracking, and signal processing algorithms, as well as their behaviors and performance.
Proven experience in system-level requirements development, documentation, maintenance, and/or the design of system-level software architecture.
Hands-on experience in developing and coding system models, algorithms, test vectors, and evaluation tools to analyze radar requirements and performance.
Demonstrated ability to develop, document, and maintain processes, methods, and tools to ensure engineering excellence.
Track record of developing technical solutions to complex engineering challenges.
Proficiency in programming languages such as python, C/C++, Java, and tools like DOORS.
Familiarity with the software development process using Agile methodologies and associated tools, such as JIRA and Confluence.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proven history of delivering innovative technical solutions.
Proficiency with the MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
Excellent communication skills, including technical writing, oral presentations, and interpersonal skills.
Previous experience interfacing with customers and leading the development of technical solutions for complex user requirements.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a geographically distributed team environment.
Experience collaborating across disciplines and communicating effectively with all levels of the organization and external stakeholders.
Advanced Degree in STEM

Clearance Requirements

Currently hold active DoD Secret Clearance.

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer (UX/UI & Systems) - Top 10 Robotics/Hard Tech Startup - Manhattan, NYC - $350k Cash + Founding Equity
jobs.description:
Founding Software Engineer (UX/UI & Systems) - Top 10 Robotics/Hard Tech Startup - Manhattan, NYC - $350k Cash + Founding Equity

We’re hiring for one of NYC’s top 10 robotics startups.
If you’re an elite engineer looking to join a high-density "A " squad - builders from SpaceX, Google, Palantir & Anduril - this
is where you want to be.

Must be based in NYC & role requires US citizenship due to regulatory constraints.

This isn't another abstracted B2B platform or a data-entry dashboard. These guys have fleets of multi-ton autonomous machines deployed globally & we’re hiring Founding Software Engineers
to build the operating system & interface that controls them.

The Team
You will be joining an A squad *-a high-density group of builders from SpaceX, Palantir, Tesla & Google
. We avoid typical corporate friction & process for the sake of process. We hire for high agency, technical depth, & a total lack of ego. As a founding hire, you won't just follow a roadmap-you will define it.

High Autonomy, no micromanagement. You will have the autonomy to own the entire frontend stack from architecture to shipping. You are the bridge between complex robotics telemetry & intuitive operational tools.
Mission Control:
Architecting the UI that handles high-frequency telemetry, 3D spatial data, & real-time fleet management.
Founding Ownership:
You choose the tools, define the architecture, & own the deployment pipeline.
Real Stakes:
You’ll work closely with hardware engineers to ensure our interfaces are as reliable as the machines they control. In this environment, a laggy interface or a confusing UI has real-world consequences.

What we're looking for

Seeking high-signal engineers (we don't care about schools, we care about your aptitude to problem solving) who have seen what to build the best again & again.
Mastery of TypeScript & React:
You understand the internals & how to build for extreme performance & low latency.
Founding Mindset:
You are comfortable with ambiguity & have a bias toward building simple, robust solutions that scale.
High-Signal Pedigree:
You’ve shipped production systems in high-bar environments (SpaceX, Tesla, or similar elite squads).
Product Sense:
You understand how to translate complex system states into intuitive, rock-solid operational tools.

Stack & Comp

Stack:
TypeScript, React, high-performance data visualization.
Location:
NYC (SoHo/Flatiron) - hybrid.
Comp:
$350k - $500k+ base + Founding Member Equity
.

The Process: 1 Week & 0 Take-Homes
We respect your time & move as fast as we ship. Our process is designed to be completed in 1 week:
(Founders) Technical Deep Dive:
A conversation about the architecture of a complex system you’ve built from the ground up.
(Team) Practical Pairing:
Solving a real-world interface or state-management problem together. No Leetcode.
(Exec) Founding Team Chat:
A focus on judgment, trade-offs, & the vision for the product.

If you’re ready to move from building digital-only products to building the interface for the physical world, let’s talk.

TL;DR

Founding Software Engineer (UX/UI & Systems)
Top 10 NYC robotics startup
Software that controls physical systems
Production ownership, real consequences
$350k-$500k+ base + equity
Hybrid - Manhattan, NYC

Equal Opportunity

We're hiring for an Equal Opportunity Employer.

*All our new jobs are posted here 1st:
linkedin.com/in/sufyanbashir/
